notes.title: Released v0.9.9 2024-02-15
notes.notes:
* fixed font scaling issues on higher screen resolutions
* added configurable keybinding

notes.title: Released v0.9.8
notes.notes:
* improved jumping: increased height of the first jump and reduced mini jetpack jump force a little bit
* redesigned visualization of acid protection level

notes.title: Released version v0.9.6
notes.notes:
* fixed overpowered enemies, when a single shot from enemy could cause damage two or three times at once
* increased colliders of enemies mele fight
* reimplemented screen resolution setting
* fixed bug with not saving on entering first outpost
* added extra ammo near the first miniboss

notes.title: Released v0.9.5 2023-12-31
notes.notes:
* hopefully improved terrain performance
* fixed order of monsters on end scene
* replaced placeholder model for RadioImpProjectile
* fixed glitching wind sound when going in a diagonal direction
* Added separate configurations for horizontal and vertical mouse sensitivity
* reduced microjetpack sound

notes.title: Fixed demo achivements
notes.notes: Unfortunately there was a bug in demo build with caused three of five achievements to be .... well unachievable. The latest fix 0.10.0 fixes that and adds two new achievements.
